label: neiso 34 import export
definition: (PROBE) Priced-interchange + dual-limb weather floor: registers import/export as its own dashboard class (the fuelRows 'interchange' row, model vs EIA-930 net interchange) the same way CAISO/PJM measure it. Surfaces a real miss — the NEISO priced import/export node OVER-IMPORTS (net import model vs actual 18.1/15.1 (2023), 18.8/10.3 (2024), 27.4/8.1 TWh (2025)): the import tranches are sized to the import envelope, not calibrated to net energy, so the LP floods cheap imports and under-runs domestic gas. Keeper stays the measured-schedule run (neiso 35); priced mode needs import-tranche price/capacity calibration before it is a keeper. Carries the new temperature-correlated reliability floor (CT_PEAKER hot-limb TMAX, COAL/ST_GAS cold-limb TMIN).
